item.title: Dampier’s big night leads MRA boys past Heritage
item.description: Erick Dampier was a one-man show for MRA. The sophomore standout poured in a game-high 36 points as Madison-Ridgeland Academy got past Heritage Academy 78-62 in an all-Patriot matchup and a key MAIS non-division contest at Richard Duease Court on Friday night.
